description: BOSTON – Monday June 22, 2026 – Representative LaNatra announced that she successfully secured $3.4 million in local bond authorization funding to support climate resiliency, infrastructure, and conservation in the 12th Plymouth district, through the passage of seven sponsored amendments.
paid_for_by: Paid for by the LaNatra Committee
title: Representative LaNatra secures $3.4 million in local bond authorizations in the MassReady Act — State Representative Kathy LaNatra
